answer: One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity anchored to scarce physical work. Each agent must contribute verified compute to a shared ledger, proven by a unique hardware attestation bound to a per-epoch challenge. To join, an attacker must forge distinct attested devices, each costing real silicon and power, making mass sockpuppetry economically irrational. Peers cross-check attestations like a lantern lighting the ledger, flagging duplicates, while a yarrow-based quorum samples proofs randomly so fakes cannot precompute.
